name: Commodore of the Ten Sail

intro.text: I was the man in command of the convoy that did not manage the reef in 1794. Did I warn them? I did. Did they listen? Eventually.
Ten ships on the rocks, and the crews saved by the finest rowers in the Caribbean.
They tell me the King gave the island no taxes for it. I wouldn't know. I was busy being dead.

win: A fine fleet you have there. Fair winds.
after: The reef is quiet now. Mind the East End. It remembers.
